project.name: Tilda — Reading HQ Boardroom Refresh
project.site_vehicles:
AB12 CDE - Ford Transit
EF34 GHI - VW Crafter

hazards.hazard: Working at height for display installation (up to 3m)
controls: Class 1 stepladders EN131 rated only; 3-point contact maintained.
Podium steps used above 2m; two-person team for bracket lifts.
Working area cordoned; no personnel permitted below drop zone.

hazards.hazard: Manual handling of large-format displays (55 kg)
controls: Team lift (2 engineers minimum) for any item over 20 kg.
Screen trolley used from vehicle to install location.
Correct lifting technique briefed at toolbox talk.
Isolation permit obtained before rack power-on.
Test-before-touch on every circuit prior to termination.

phases.title: Site Set-Up and Delivery
steps: Sign in at reception; complete site induction with facilities team.
Position vehicles per client's delivery-zone plan; deploy dust sheets.
Establish welfare and rest area; agree comms channel with site contact.

phases.title: First Fix — Cable Pulls and Bracket Installation
steps: Confirm cable routes with site facilities; obtain ceiling-void permit if needed.
Pull power and structured cabling to each device location.
Install VESA brackets to walls (verify wall construction; use reinforcement plate if plasterboard).

phases.title: Second Fix — Display and Rack Installation
steps: Terminate structured cabling; label per site cable-schedule.
Install AV rack; power-on with electrical isolation permit.

phases.title: Commissioning and Handover
steps: Configure Biamp DSP; upload Crestron control code.
Walk client contact through system operation; sign off Section 8.

tools_and_equipment: Insulated hand tools (screwdrivers, pliers, wire strippers)
Cordless drill 18V with masonry + wood bits
PPE: safety footwear, dust masks FFP2, safety glasses
Laptop for DSP configuration and device testing
client_responsibilities: Mains power outlets live at each equipment location.
Network drops (Cat6) active and PoE-enabled where applicable.
Boardroom booked out and empty on installation days.
Client IT contact available for VLAN cutover.
Site contact available throughout the working day.

decommission.notes: Return to client store for spares.

retained.notes: Retained; retest and rebalance during commissioning.

generated_data.scope_of_works: Refresh of the Reading HQ main boardroom AV. Decommission legacy displays and matrix switcher; install dual 4K displays, Biamp DSP, Shure ceiling microphones, and Crestron NVX / control system. Retain existing ceiling speakers.

programme.welfare_notes: Client welfare block available; toilets and kitchen accessible.
programme.waste_removal_notes: 21st Century AV to remove all packaging and legacy equipment.

room_overviews.overview: 16-seat executive boardroom. Dual-wall displays, ceiling microphones, table-mounted control.
room_overviews.works_summary:
- Decommission legacy 65" LCD.
- Install dual Samsung QM86R displays (front + rear wall).
- Install 2× Shure MXA710 ceiling microphones.
- Table-mounted Crestron TSW-1070.
- Commission with Biamp DSP and Crestron control.

room_overviews.overview: AV rack room adjacent to boardroom. New DSP + NVX distribution + Crestron control processor.
room_overviews.works_summary:
- Decommission legacy matrix switcher.
- Install Biamp TesiraFORTÉ VT4.
- Install 4× Crestron NVX-352.
- Install Crestron CP4-R control processor.
- Terminate and label structured cabling.

site_emergency.fire_extinguisher_class: Class A + Class C (CO2) in AV rack

exclusions: No structural works or core drilling.
No decorative making-good after cable routes.
No IT network provision — client to provide active drops.
No decommissioning of unrelated legacy equipment beyond items listed in scope.

decommissioning.labelling_procedure: All decommissioned items labelled with 21CAV asset tag showing removal date + engineer initials.
steps: Photograph in-situ before removal for asset register.
Disconnect and label cables at both ends.
Transport to client store; obtain client signature.

commissioning_criteria.pass_condition: Both displays lock and display test pattern without artefacts

commissioning_criteria.criterion: MXA710 ceiling mics pick up speech at 4m radius
commissioning_criteria.pass_condition: AEC + AGC delivers intelligible speech to far-end

commissioning_criteria.criterion: Crestron TSW-1070 initiates call and controls volume
commissioning_criteria.pass_condition: All buttons respond within 500ms; no page-load errors
